newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Tobacco hits high for calendar 1997.
newsitem.headline: Japan Tobacco hits high for calendar 1997.

text.p: Japan Tobacco Inc shares rose to a high on Monday morning for calendar 1997, bolstered by the scheduled listing this autumn of privatised firm Central Japan Railway Co, brokers said.
As of 0138 GMT, the shares were up 39,000 yen at 935,000, after briefly rising to a high of 942,000.

"With Central Japan Railway coming up, there is speculation that privatised firms will become popular and buying is emerging," a broker at a middle-sized brokerage said. "But on the other hand, somewhere down the road selling of shares such as JT may emerge as investors switch to the new issue."
